scope: Independent read-only pixel review of five published-legacy screenshots plus supplied browser measurements; not overall P08 acceptance.

passes.evidence: All five images show the top banner: published legacy dataset / UI-only visual review, with new 13 cases/original catalog/provider marked unloaded.

Supplied measurements report scroll dimensions equal viewport at 390x844, 844x390, 1280x720 and 1600x1000; images show the footer contained in the viewport. This checks observed behavior, not CSS syntax or browser-toolbar resize handling.
390x844 measurement: graph x=0,y=175.875,width=390,height=610.125. Portrait screenshot has an unobstructed, centered 3-node neighborhood.

Desktop visible legend entries have distinct colored shapes, including the purple hollow predicate ring. Supplied report provides ten computed category colors; not all ten rows are simultaneously visible in the desktop image because the navigator scrolls internally.

Initial dense desktop cloud is near the graph-panel center; focused neighborhoods are near center in the portrait, landscape, 1280x720 and selected-edge images. No screenshot shows the active graph pinned to a corner.

selected-edge-desktop.png has a dark emphasized directed edge and a right-hand relation inspector with the exact edge ID e:31d903f09082e2bd61743032, raw type produces_check_result, and source/target context. This passes selection identity/distinction; endpoint visibility has a remaining hover-tooltip defect.
The three node names and two relation labels are readable in the mobile and 1280x720 neighborhood screenshots; this does not establish readability for the dense initial overview.

remaining_defects.defect: The supplied mobile_graph_500px=true aggregate check does not cover the landscape viewport. Literal >=500px graph height is unmet at 844x390; only portrait satisfies it. Fixed 390px viewport height, visible chrome and a fully visible 500px graph cannot all fit without a separate policy for landscape overflow/clipping/scrolling.

The dense overview still crowds labels into the central/lower cloud. Repeated 夹具检查结果 · _pre_start / _execution labels and resource/entity labels overlap or compete with colored nodes and intersecting links. Several muted labels are difficult to associate with a single node. Sparse-neighborhood readability does not resolve this overview defect. No numeric text-contrast ratio was measured.

The visible hover tooltip (roughly x884–1067,y582–648) overlaps the lower-right gray endpoint and its 检查绑定 label. The emphasized edge and relation inspector remain clear, but the complete source-endpoint context is obscured in this captured hover state.

not_independently_verified: Pointer/keyboard interactions and drawer dismissal are reported true by browser-report.json but were not rerun in this pixel-only review.
Actual 100dvh CSS declaration and dynamic mobile browser toolbar changes were not inspected.
Original catalog, 13 accepted cases, native Provider execution and scientific validity remain outside loaded/public UI review.
Dense mobile full-graph readability was not shown by the supplied neighborhood screenshots.
overall: Partial visual pass within published legacy scope. Three listed pixel defects remain; no whole-P08 acceptance is asserted.
mutations: Only this independent-pixel-review.json report was written; no source, service, test or Git state was changed.
